units: <cite ref="Shabbat 33b:4">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>תינוקות של בית ר׳</he> school children.

Tosef. Eduy. III, 4 [read.] מי שיש לו תלמידים ותלמידי תלמידיו קוראין אותו רבי נשתכחו תלמידיו קוראין אותו ר׳ וכ׳ if a scholar has disciples and disciples of his disciples, he is quoted (by the latter) as Rabbi; if his direct disciples are forgotten (in tradition), he is quoted as Rabban; if both are forgotten, he is quoted by his name.—Esp. Rabban, title of most of the presidents of Palestinian colleges that succeeded Hillel.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ib. II, 8</cite>; a. fr. (v., respective proper names).—Pl. <he>רַבָּנִים</he>, <he>רַבָּנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10">Cant. R. to I, 10</cite> <he>נאוו</he> … <he>אלו הר׳ וכ׳</he> ‘comely are thy cheeks’ &c. (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10">ib.</cite>), this refers to the teachers, ‘thy neck with strings’, refers to the students &c. (v. <cite ref="H01646"><he>חָרַז</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 983:3">Yalk. ib. 983</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:1">Gen.
